## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `swift build` passes.
- [ ] `scripts/build-app.sh release` passes.
- [ ] Relevant behavior checked manually; results described below.
- [ ] Documentation/spec updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] Screenshots and diagnostics contain no keys or private content.

Include macOS version, manual checks, screenshots for visual changes, and anything unverified.
